Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production-ready full-map background for a 2D top-down survivor drawing game, not a UI mockup.
Image 1 is the APPROVED style reference only. Match its restrained dark paper / dry ink printmaking art exactly: broad angular muted warm-gray walls, nearly black ink shadow shapes, sparse ivory scuffs, minimal rust-red. No watercolor bloom, no blue night tint, no ornate fantasy, no colorful cartoon, no photorealism.
Image 2 is a STRICT spatial layout guide, not artwork: gray outside permits architecture and decoration; charcoal interior must remain completely free of buildings and props; pink boundary is a technical guide and must disappear. Preserve its placement and scale. Replace gray with illustrated scenery. The playable central ground and all surrounding open ground share near-uniform charcoal #252621 paper with very subtle fiber. No bright grid or floor tiles. No horizon, no vanishing point, fixed high three-quarter orthographic camera, modest wall faces for depth.
Wide 3:2 full-bleed landscape, target 1536x1024. Keep scenery behind action: mostly #191a17 shadows, warm ash #625c4e building masses; tiny dull ivory edge marks only. Strong simple silhouettes, no dense crosshatching or excessive tiny details. Central empty ground stays very dark and uncluttered. Do not add a painted frame or a solid perimeter outline. No HUD, text, letters, numbers, icons, minimap, people, heroes, enemies, skulls, weapons, paint attacks, or watermark.

Border architecture mostly standing: shuttered studios, simple worn shop doors, blank hanging signs, a few chipped steps, benches, closed barrels, wooden crates, iron railing and sparse dead shrubs. Structures cluster in the large OUTSIDE corner pockets and follow the irregular guide outline. Large readable shapes, varied depths and heights, some structures cut off by image edges. Intact but tired, not cheerful. ONLY three or four tiny dim warm-ivory lamps/windows embedded in outer walls, no large light pools. Respect every inward and outward bend of the central safe region, all solid scenery lies OUTSIDE it. The central ground must occupy exactly the same irregular shape as image 2, subtly merging with dark paving at the base of the boundary buildings.

Missing roofs, broken angular wall silhouettes, black exposed beams, leaning iron fencing, a few stark bare trees, barrels, broken benches and masonry along outer perimeter. All solid scenery remains OUTSIDE image 2's central rectangle (x256..1280, y171..853 in 1536x1024). Do not turn the scenery into four straight walls or a neat rectangular box: broken clusters vary dramatically in depth, gaps, height and jaggedness OUTSIDE the protected rectangle. Center remains continuous empty charcoal paper ground, not a bordered play mat. Major wrecked wall clusters at upper-left and upper-right, sparse broken fences and bare branches across bottom corners. ONLY three tiny dim warm-ivory surviving lamps/windows in outer walls. Much more ruined than an intact courtyard, while still restrained and readable.
floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 2D game ground texture, wide 3:2 1536x1024. Use the attached approved image ONLY as a reference for its charcoal paper floor. Generate ONLY a clean empty near-uniform charcoal paper / dry ink ground. Base color #252621, tiny understated warm-gray paper fibers, very low-contrast large patches with near-identical values. A few extremely sparse faint dry-brush scuffs, no bright marks. Equal illumination at all edges, no vignette, no seam, no frame, no obvious tiling. This texture lies under colorful player drawings and must stay visually quiet. Absolutely no buildings, props, walls, plants, people, creatures, shadows of objects, UI, text, border, grid, bricks, tile seams, symbols, strong cracks, photographs or gradient glow. Do not reproduce the HUD or any subject from the reference.
